section.para:
Thumbnails and other cached data can be maintained from the dialog accessible by selecting

section.para: The utilities listed here operate on the Geeqie caching mechanism. This also includes the data cached for the search and find duplicates utilities.

section.title: Create file similarity cache
section.para:
Some file operations, such as search and find duplicates , are speeded up if similarity data files for the images have been created. This utility will create sim. files recursively under the specified folder.
The sim. files contain some or all of the following fields:
Dimensions
width x height
Date
Exif date in time_t format
checksum
MD5sum 32 character ascii text digest
SimilarityGrid
[32 x 32] = 3072 bytes of data (1024 pixels in RGB format, 1 pixel is 24bits)

section.title: Background Cache Maintenance
section.para: Select Select in the Background cache maintenance section, enter or choose a folder, and select Start. Geeqie launches the command line program described below as a separate background job, creating thumbnails and similarity data for the selected folder and all its subfolders. The initial cleanup removes orphaned entries from Geeqie's cache, not just entries for the selected folder.

Thumbnail caching must be enabled in the saved Preferences. Desktop notifications report the maintenance stage and provide a Quit button while maintenance is running. The viewer remains available during the background job.

section.title: Command line program
section.para: Geeqie can be run as a command line program: GQ_CACHE_MAINTENANCE=y[es] geeqie --cache-maintenance=<path to images>. It will recursively remove orphaned thumbnails and .sim files, and create thumbnails and similarity data for all images found.
It may also be called from cron or anacron thus enabling automatic updating of the cached data for all your images.

section.title: Scheduling cache maintenance
section.para: Run scheduled maintenance as the same user who normally runs Geeqie. Start Geeqie normally at least once and save its configuration before scheduling maintenance. Thumbnail caching must be enabled in Preferences. If you use custom XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, or XDG_DATA_HOME values, set the same values in the maintenance script.

Although maintenance does not open a viewer window, the current GTK4 implementation requires a display connection. For jobs without a desktop session, install Xvfb, xvfb-run (including its xauth dependency), and dbus-run-session using your distribution's package manager. The following wrapper supplies a virtual display and a private D-Bus session.

Save this script as $HOME/.local/bin/geeqie-cache-maintenance, creating the directory if necessary. Replace /usr/bin/geeqie with the absolute path reported by command -v geeqie, and replace the image folder with your own. Check the paths to the wrapper programs too. Quoting the image folder allows spaces in its name.
